'''Jeremy Bulloch''' was a special guest at [[DecipherCon 1999]], billed as Boba Fett from the Star Wars films. He signed photographs with [[Shannon Baksa]] (Mara Jade).<ref name="fri27">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000612184011/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri27.html DecipherCon 1999 Friday photo fri27], Decipher (Wayback 12 June 2000). Caption: "Celebrity guest Jeremy Bulloch, 'Boba Fett' from the Star Wars trilogy, stands tall as Shannon Baksa, Decipher's Mara Jade, signs photos for fans"</ref><ref name="guests">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000122135443/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Special guests], DecipherCon '99 (Wayback 22 January 2000)</ref>
